name: Constraint-Preserving Hidden-State Embedding Family
definition: Cross-API refinement of the hidden-state embedding problem. Candidate embeddings must preserve the existing hidden/base and inheritance commuting laws and land in the physical kernel of the Time-Space native constraint algebra.
math: Emb_H,phys^R={ iota_H:E_H^R↪E | pi_E∘iota_H=j_T∘pi_H; I∘iota_H=iota_H∘I_H; iota_H(E_H^R)⊆ker(C) }. API4.3 supplies C_a|Psi_phys>=0, U ker(C)⊆ker(C), and C_read Pi_T=Pi_T C_native on admissible states. The family is defined; nonemptiness/selection of a physical iota_H remains open.

name: Hidden S3 Relational-State Bundle
definition: Type-normalized bundle candidate for the time-indexed hidden S3 network organization. Its existence as a smooth admissible bundle is conditional on the declared hidden relational history.
math: π_H:E_H^R→T_H, with fiber state R_H(t)=(V_t,E_t,w_t,χ_t,H_t)_R. This types the domain of iota_H; it does not itself prove iota_H exists.

name: Hidden S3 State Embedding into Inherited State Bundle
definition: Primary open selection/existence problem after bidirectional cross-crawl: select a physical embedding from @dm_constraint_preserving_embedding_family. The family is typed; nonemptiness and a realized embedding remain open.
math: Select iota_H∈Emb_H,phys^R. Required: pi_E∘iota_H=j_T∘pi_H; I∘iota_H=iota_H∘I_H; iota_H(E_H^R)⊆ker(C).
